notes.title: Development news - May 2025
notes.content:
It’s been a quiet couple of months, but development on Infinium has been moving full steam ahead. Here’s a quick look at what’s new:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45235239/3a9e4168be6cdc33bf83ea5f36451e477ed19641.gif[/img]
1. Demo Feedback & Improvements
[list]
[*] Several of your suggestions are already in the game
[*] More feedback-driven changes are in the works
[/list][b]Thanks for playing the demo and sharing your thoughts![/b]

2. Combat & Enemy System Overhaul
[list]
[*] Rebuilt from the ground up to support new mechanics like parrying and much more
[*] Enemies now behave more naturally using a finite state machine
[*] Improved hit feedback for a snappier feel
[/list]3. Engine Upgrade 
[list]
[*] Upgraded to Unity 2022, bringing better input handling, smoother performance, and more stability.
[/list][b]Because of the scale of changes after the demo, I’ve been revisiting and updating various parts of the game. ACT 2 of the game is now fully playable![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45235239/1fa5e6270abcf1bc5c00e8453001b432bd21a8de.gif[/img]
What’s Next?
1. Rework the remaining parts of the game
[spoiler]2. Add the Player Hub and buddy [/spoiler]
3. Design and implement Boss Fights
4. Release date announcement 🎉

Thanks for sticking around – more updates coming soon!

notes.title: Steam Next Fest and demo 1.05 update is here!
notes.content:
Steam Next Fest February 2025 is here, and so is the 1.05 update to Infinium: A Spaceboy's Tale demo!

[i]Changelog:
- add blocked by connected enemies portal feature to level 3 and level 4
- player is faster during attack animation now
- red crab enemy rebalance
- warp to last checkpoint sequence is 2x faster
- adjust out of level detection to start warp to last checkpoint sequence quicker
- improve falling tile logic
- update skip text in introductory cutscene
- improve flying enemy[/i]

After reviewing some feedback, I've decided to restrict some areas in the second half of Act 1. So now, there are two spots where the player is required to kill proper enemies to unlock access to the further part of the level. Keep playing, share your feedback and enjoy the Next Fest!

Matt Glad

notes.title: Demo of Infinium: A Spaceboy's Tale is available now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45235239/9adb9abe542b9d2bc70aef570c929502cf694782.png[/img]

[h3][b]Demo is here![/b][/h3]
[h3]Head out to the game's Steam page and download it![/h3]

Short demo description:

[i]Experience the whole first act! Unveil dark secrets as you traverse through Leo's biggest dreams. Face various creatures with unique behavior sets, unlock new skills, and time your jumps well! Deep dive into the world of Infinium. Leo is waiting for you![/i]

Demo features:
[list]
[*]whole first act of the game
[*]3 unique creatures 
[*]jump, run and dash through 4 exciting levels
[*]gamepad support
[/list]
After playing the demo, fill out the in-game quick survey and leave some feedback in the Steam discussion. Every suggestion and criticism will be appreciated!

Hope you enjoy it! 
Have fun during Steam Next Fest!
Matt Glad

notes.title: Steam Next Fest participation and development news!
notes.content:
[h2]2025 is here, and I would love to share some exciting news with you!
[/h2]

[h2]Steam Next Fest demo is coming![/h2]
First of all, the [b]demo of Infinium: A Spaceboy's Tale[/b] will be playable during [b]Steam Next Fest: February 2025![/b] The [b]whole first act[/b] will be part of the demo. Right now I'm working very hard to give you an amazing and flawless experience.

[h2]Tutorial rework[/h2]
As a part of that work, I'm currently remaking the tutorial level to introduce players to the game in the best possible way. Sneak peek below!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45235239/dd72353db5e6356a215919f1d18b0f48b93784d2.gif[/img]

[h2]What else?[/h2]
Apart from the tutorial, I've been working on various elements of the game, like decorating levels, improving multiple gameplay mechanics, adding new sounds, and reworking some cutscenes. Also, I've just started designing a [spoiler]boss fight![/spoiler]

That's all for now! I wish you a happy new year, and stay tuned for more!

notes.title: Steam page is up and some more details!
notes.content:
Hello Steam Community!

I'm proud to show all of you what I've been working on for the past 3 years. I've been interested in video games since I was a child, and my dream was always to create my own and publish it on Steam. It all started as a final project for my IT studies and turned into this exciting game. I'm going to post some development progress here from time to time and show overviews of the in-game mechanics and story. Most of the gameplay elements and levels are finished. Still, there is always room for further polish and new features. That's why I aim for a release in 2025.

[b]Add the game to your wishlist if you like my work so far![/b]
